categories.name: Camera motion
checks: Move matches the named preset (dolly, slider, arc, pedestal, reveal, glide, pass).
No sudden jumps, whip-pans, or snap zooms.
Ease-in / ease-out present; hold exists at the end.
Only one primary move per shot.

categories.name: Architecture
checks: Wall planes, openings, and ceiling/floor junctions match the input still.
Window placement and mullion count stable.
No invented rooms or disappearing architecture.

categories.name: Furniture rigidity
checks: Sofas, tables, beds, and casegoods keep their silhouette.
No melting legs, stretching cushions, or sliding pieces.

categories.name: Object count
checks: No duplicated lamps, chairs, rugs, or art.
No vanished hero objects that existed in the first frame.

categories.name: Geometry drift
checks: Room volume does not slowly shear or inflate.
Vanishing points stay consistent with a real camera path.

categories.name: Morphing
checks: No object-to-object morphs.
No face-like or organic melting on millwork or upholstery.

categories.name: Texture consistency
checks: Wood grain, stone, fabric weave, and metal remain the same materials.
No texture swimming, crawling grout, or pattern teleport.

categories.name: Lighting consistency
checks: Key direction and color temperature match the still.
Practicals do not pop on/off.
No new unexplained light sources.

categories.name: Exposure flicker
checks: No frame-to-frame pumping.
Windows do not strobe.
SeedVR2 4K pass must not reintroduce flicker.

categories.name: Ending composition
checks: Designed ending is present: hero hold, fade (post), branded end-card, or CTA hold.
Last second is stable enough to slate or overlay type.
Campaign Shot B lands on the intended last_frame when FL2VA was used.

categories.name: Overall luxury / taste quality
checks: Reads as high-end real-estate cinematography, not a toy camera.
Materials look expensive and physical.
Nothing campy, cartoon, or over-sharpened after 4K.
